question: In which position did India finish in the Para Asian Games event in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India secured the **5th position** in the overall medal tally of the **2023 Para Asian Games**, held in Hangzhou, China.
 
• The Indian contingent won a total of **111 medals**, including 29 gold, 31 silver, and 51 bronze medals.
 
• This was India's **best-ever performance** in the history of the Para Asian Games.
 
• China topped the medal tally, followed by Iran, Japan, and South Korea, with India emerging as a significant sporting nation in para sports.
 
• The 2023 Para Asian Games were held from **October 22 to October 28, 2023**, and saw participation from over 40 countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Para Asian Games Overview**

 
 
• The Para Asian Games, also known as the Asian Para Games, is a multi-sport event held every four years for athletes with disabilities, organized by the Asian Paralympic Committee.
 
• The event promotes inclusivity and celebrates the achievements of para-athletes across Asia.
 
• The first edition of the Para Asian Games was held in Guangzhou, China, in 2010.
 
 
 
• **India's Growth in Para Sports**
 
 
• India has made significant progress in para sports, thanks to the efforts of organizations like the **Paralympic Committee of India**.
 
• Government initiatives such as the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** and increased funding have contributed to improved performances.
 
 
 
• **Key Indian Athletes in 2023 Para Asian Games**
 
 
• Star performers included **Sumit Antil** (gold in javelin throw) and **Avani Lekhara** (gold in shooting).
 
• Several debutants also made a significant impact, showcasing India's depth in para sports.
 
 
 
• **Hangzhou 2023 Highlights**
 
 
• The Games featured 22 sports, including athletics, swimming, badminton, and table tennis.
 
• Advanced facilities and high-tech arrangements in Hangzhou ensured a smooth and inclusive event for all participants.
